title: Suoni e parole parlate
objective: By the end you can hear the difference between single and double consonants and follow short spoken exchanges.
grammarFocus: Double consonants, rhythm of short sentences, greetings and ordering at the bar.

lessons.title: Una consonante o due?
lessons.goal: You can hear and say the difference between single and double consonants.
lessons.takeaway: Double consonants are held longer: pala is short, palla is long.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta e ripeti subito dopo, con lo stesso ritmo.

exercises.title: Doppie: tienile più a lungo
exercises.body:
In Italian a **double consonant** is held for longer.

- pala (shovel) / palla (ball)\n- caro (dear) / carro (cart)

exercises.instruction: Ascolta le due parole e di' solo la prima.
exercises.explanation: Palla has a long l: hold it before you release the sound.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta le due parole e di' solo la prima.
exercises.explanation: Carro has a long r. Say it as if you stop for a moment before the vowel.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta le due parole e di' solo la prima.
exercises.explanation: Sette has a long t, held for a beat.

exercises.question: How old is the speaker?
exercises.explanation: Sette (seven) has a long t; sete (thirst) is short.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta e scrivi le parole che mancano.
exercises.audioText: Ciao, mi chiamo Marco. Sono di Milano.
exercises.explanation: Mi chiamo is how you say your name. Listen for the name of the city at the end.

exercises.instruction: Rispondi a voce, con frasi complete.
exercises.prompt: Come ti chiami e di dove sei?
exercises.modelAnswer: Mi chiamo Anna e sono di Roma.

lessons.title: Al bar, ascolta e rispondi
lessons.goal: You can follow and repeat a short exchange at the bar.
lessons.takeaway: Vorrei… per favore is the polite way to order, at any bar.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta e ripeti subito dopo, con lo stesso ritmo.
exercises.translation: I would like a coffee, please.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta e ripeti subito dopo, con lo stesso ritmo.

sentences: Ecco a te. Sono due euro.
exercises.question: Ascolta le frasi e toccale nell'ordine giusto.
exercises.explanation: A café exchange goes: greeting, order, the price, thanks.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta e scrivi le parole che mancano.
exercises.audioText: Buongiorno! Vorrei un tè e un cornetto, per favore.
exercises.text: Buongiorno! Vorrei un ___ e un ___, per favore.
exercises.explanation: Vorrei is followed by the thing you want.

exercises.instruction: Ascolta le due parole e di' solo la prima.

exercises.audioText: Mi dà due caffè, per favore?
exercises.question: What does the customer want?
exercises.explanation: Due caffè: two coffees. Listen for the number.

exercises.instruction: Rispondi a voce, con frasi complete.
exercises.prompt: Ordina un cappuccino e un cornetto.
exercises.modelAnswer: Vorrei un cappuccino e un cornetto, per favore.
